content.title: About
content.content: Chicken patty, breaded is a ready‑to‑cook product made from minced chicken breast formed into a round patty and coated with a crispy breadcrumb crust. It is convenient for quick frying or baking and is suitable for both home and commercial kitchens.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken patties are a staple in fast‑food menus, especially in burgers and sandwiches.
The breading often contains herbs, spices, and seasoned crumbs for extra flavor.
The product is usually sold in vacuum‑sealed packs to extend shelf life.
Chicken is one of the most affordable sources of high‑quality protein, and the breading adds a satisfying crunch.
In many countries, chicken patties are used as a lower‑fat alternative to beef patties.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Chicken provides all essential amino acids needed for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with beef patties, chicken versions typically contain less saturated fat.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B6 and B12 support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Source of selenium
items.content: Selenium acts as an antioxidant, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Easily digestible
items.content: Chicken meat is quickly digested, making it suitable for light or diet meals.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The breading is often salted; people monitoring sodium intake should watch portion size.

items.title: Bacterial contamination risk
items.content: Improper storage can lead to growth of Salmonella; always follow use‑by dates and keep refrigerated.

items.title: Monosodium glutamate (MSG)
items.content: Some breading recipes include MSG, which may cause sensitivity in certain consumers.

content.title: How to Cook
content.content: The patty can be pan‑fried with a little oil, baked in a preheated oven at 180 °C for 20‑25 minutes, or cooked in an air fryer. Let the patty come to room temperature before cooking for even heat distribution.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at +2…+4 °C in the original packaging for up to 5 days after opening. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C, where it retains quality for up to 3 months. Before use, check for off‑odors or discoloration.
